description: 30 cached queries (anchors). Each has one paraphrase that should reuse the cached answer and one near-miss that needs a different answer. Written for this repo and frozen before the first experiment run.

near_miss_types.number: a quantity, year, price or duration changes
near_miss_types.negation: the request is negated (not, don't, without, no)
near_miss_types.role_swap: the same words, but two entities trade places (from/to, A vs. B)
near_miss_types.entity: one entity is replaced by a different one
near_miss_types.antonym: a direction or polarity word is flipped (increase/decrease, oldest/newest)
